title: revision
description: Where each part of a design the board shows stands now, from describe revision: one cheap fingerprint per part, so a reader asks often and fetches only the parts whose fingerprint moved. Fingerprints are compared, never read: their bytes mean nothing beyond equal or not.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Revision, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: One fingerprint per part, each 16 lower-case hex characters that change when that part changes.

board.description: The design as Go takes it: every file of the design but layout.yml, and the build that reads them; when it moves, a reader fetches describe board and config again.

layout.description: layout.yml alone, so a moved box refetches only the positions, not the board.

features.description: The machine's feature switches, as get features answers them.

meta.description: The build's version and the design checkout's git state (its HEAD, the ref it points to, its index); a reader fetches the board's version and git facts again when it moves, or when board does, since those name the last change.

runs.description: The runs kept for the design: how many there are and the newest; a reader fetches the run list again when it moves.
